name: CDIL Semiconductors Private Limited
india_angle: CDIL operates four semiconductor manufacturing units in India, located in Delhi and Mohali.
summary: Continental Device India Ltd (CDIL) is a prominent semiconductor manufacturer based in India, specializing in the production of silicon chips and devices. With extensive manufacturing facilities in India, CDIL offers a wide range of semiconductor products including transistors, diodes, and rectifiers, serving both local and international markets.
